verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an analytics product. That could mean an opt-out from the product's own telemetry or a visitor or owner exclusion mechanism, but the pack documents neither. The privacy claims (no personal data, no consent banner) and the self-hosting option are adjacent privacy posture, not a documented opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
